article-product-visual-system.title: 从产品卖点到商业视觉：科技产品 KV 的组织方式
article-product-visual-system.excerpt: 记录如何把硬件功能、应用场景和营销语言整理成可传播的产品主视觉。
article-product-visual-system.content:
科技产品视觉不能只停留在“好看”。更重要的是把用户能理解的卖点组织出来：核心功能是什么，使用场景在哪里，为什么值得相信。

我的做法通常是先拆产品功能，再找最有商业价值的场景，最后把图像、标题、功能 icon 和局部说明压缩成一个清晰的信息层级。

article-brand-to-touchpoints.title: 品牌系统如何落到产品、展会和物料
article-brand-to-touchpoints.excerpt: 品牌不是一张 logo 图，而是一套能在产品、包装、展台和画册里连续出现的识别系统。
article-brand-to-touchpoints.content:
品牌系统的难点在于落地一致性。Logo、颜色、字体和图形语言需要进入产品铭牌、包装、展会画面、宣传册和网页界面。

当这些触点都能被同一套视觉规则连接起来时，品牌才会形成稳定的专业感。

article-ai-workflow.title: AI 辅助创意在设计流程中的位置
article-ai-workflow.excerpt: AI 更适合放在概念探索和场景草图阶段，最终质量仍取决于设计判断和后期整合。
article-ai-workflow.content:
AI 可以快速生成方向，但不能替代设计判断。更有效的流程是 Idea → AI Sketch → Scene Building → PS Retouch → Marketing Final。

在这个流程里，AI 负责拓宽可能性，设计师负责筛选、重构、统一风格并把画面做成可交付的商业视觉。

article-product-visual-system.title: From Product Benefits to Commercial Visuals: Structuring Technology Product KV
article-product-visual-system.excerpt: How hardware functions, use scenarios and marketing language can be organized into a clear product key visual.
article-product-visual-system.content:
Technology product visuals should go beyond looking attractive. The more important task is to organize benefits that users can understand: what the core function is, where it is used and why it is trustworthy.

My usual process is to break down product functions first, identify the most commercially valuable scenario, then compress imagery, headline, feature icons and detail notes into a clear information hierarchy.

article-brand-to-touchpoints.title: How a Brand System Extends into Products, Exhibitions and Collateral
article-brand-to-touchpoints.excerpt: A brand is not a single logo image, but an identity system that appears consistently across products, packaging, booths and brochures.
article-brand-to-touchpoints.content:
The challenge of a brand system is consistency in real applications. Logo, color, typography and graphic language need to enter product nameplates, packaging, exhibition visuals, brochures and interface screens.

When these touchpoints are connected by the same visual rules, the brand begins to feel stable and professional.

article-ai-workflow.title: Where AI-assisted Creativity Fits in the Design Workflow
article-ai-workflow.excerpt: AI works best in concept exploration and scene sketching, while final quality still depends on design judgment and integration.
article-ai-workflow.content:
AI can generate directions quickly, but it cannot replace design judgment. A more effective workflow is Idea → AI Sketch → Scene Building → PS Retouch → Marketing Final.

In this process, AI expands the range of possibilities, while the designer selects, restructures, unifies the style and turns the image into a deliverable commercial visual.
